WORDS → COMMANDS → SCRIPT

Your next script starts here.

  1. Find an action. Search tasks, symptoms, cmdlets, or event IDs. Match hints explain results; Search tips offers filters.
  2. Make it yours. Configure each step, then use the arrows to reorder it. The preview updates as you type.
  3. Review and export. Copy or download the script. Shellify never runs it.

Scripts have not been tested in your environment. Check permissions, modules, and compatibility before running. Service restarts can interrupt users; confirmation is enabled by default.

Scripts & workflows

Move between devices

Export an editable .shellify.json project to keep or share. Importing replaces your draft and can be undone. Project files include your targets, paths, and settings.

Saved scripts

Starter workflows

Workflows add steps to the end of your current script. They do not replace your draft. Undo removes the insertion. Service troubleshooting does not restart anything; add and explicitly configure a restart if needed.

DEFINE ONCE

Shared inputs

Reuse a hostname, folder, service name, or domain controller across steps. Link fields using their value-source selector. Scripts use the resolved values as safely quoted literals.
